set.body:
Outcome

Create the authoritative key-to-ordinal binding and Multivar space witness.

Acceptance

- Semantic keys are unique, ordered, and recoverable from ordinals.
- RowOrdinal is never accepted as SampleId or FeatureId.
- Runtime-decoded evidence binds to an existing nominal witness after descriptor validation.
- Reordering derives a distinct axis and explicit relation.
- The noncanonical sample regression is fixed.
set.title: P1.2: implement AxisRef, SampleId, FeatureId, and private RowOrdinal
